answer: An agent posts a refundable 480 POA bond locked 150 days on one device key, one bond per identity, so a farm locks 480 POA per fake. A prism audit splits the record into identity, work, and payments, with three random auditors each checking one facet weekly. One failed facet sends a ripple through the record and forces a recheck before it earns. Fifteen clean weeks earn an opal credential for paid work; a forged facet or shared key burns the bond, revokes the opal, and bars it for a year.
